chunks: Yūnus ibn Yaʿqūb asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about the funeral prayer being performed without wudu (ablution), so he said:
"Yes. It is only takbīr, tasbīḥ, taḥmīd, and tahlīl, just as you recite takbīr and tasbīḥ in your home."

key_terms.الْجِنَازَةِ: the funeral bier or funeral prayer context
key_terms.يُصَلَّى: is prayed; the act of performing prayer

ai.seo_question: Can salat al-janazah be performed without wudu (ablution)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling that salat al-janazah may be performed without wudu (ablution). The Imam عليه السلام explains that it consists of forms of dhikr such as takbīr, tasbīḥ, taḥmīd, and tahlīl, indicating that it does not require the same state of ritual purity as other prayers.
